transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I just can’t seem to keep my mind on things the way I used to. Um. At work, I'll just stare at a loan worksheet, or a client follow-up list, and... I just end up rereading the same line over and over. Then I just put off making the calls. It just seems like... even simple decisions feel harder than they should right now.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

I suppose... yes. Um. It's more just... this dull heaviness most days. Even if I'm at the community center, or out in my garden... places I usually like... I just feel like I'm going through the motions. Just... pasting a smile on, I guess.
Have you experienced any loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy?
I don't think so. Um... I still do my gardening and everything. I just... I don't know. I haven't stopped doing them, if that's what you mean.
How long have you been feeling this dull heaviness?
Um... a while, I guess. It's been... well, a little over two years now. Since my close friend passed away.
Do you have difficulty sleeping or are you sleeping more than usual?
I don't think so. Um... I sleep about the same as I always have, I suppose. I haven't really noticed a change.
Do you have feelings of worthlessness or guilt?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean... I don't really feel guilty about anything, or... worthless. So, no. I wouldn't say that.
Do you feel like you're able to enjoy things as much as you used to, even if you're still doing them?

Um... not really, I suppose. I still do things... like go to the community center, or work in my garden. But... I don't know. That heaviness is just kind of sitting with me most days. I guess I just feel like I'm going through the motions... just pasting a smile on. It doesn't really lift me up like it used to.
Do you feel like these feelings of dull heaviness are interfering with your daily life a lot?

I suppose... maybe a little. Um... at the credit office, I've... I've started postponing some of my client follow-ups lately. And... I guess I've stepped back from some other things, too. Like the walking club... or those gallery events I used to make a point of going to. I just... haven't been.
Would you say these feelings of dull heaviness are interfering with your daily life most of the time?
Um... I'm not really sure. I mean... I still go to work. I still get things done, mostly. So... maybe not most of the time. Just... sometimes.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are present nearly every day?

Um... yes. I suppose so. Like I mentioned... most days, that heaviness is just kind of... sitting there with me. Even when I'm trying to just put on a smile and get through things... it's usually there.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are significantly impacting your ability to function at work or in your daily activities?

Well... like I mentioned a few minutes ago... I suppose it is. I mean... I have been putting off those client follow-ups at the office. And... I've stepped back from the walking club and those gallery outings. So... yes. I guess it is impacting things.
Have you experienced these feelings of dull heaviness for more than two years continuously?
Um... yes. I suppose it has. It's been... a little over two years. Since... well, a close friend of mine died around then. It's just been going on since then.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are making it very difficult for you to carry out your daily activities?

I think I already said this, but... yes. I've been putting off my client follow-ups at the credit office. And... I just don't go to the gallery events or the walking club anymore. I just... can't seem to manage it.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are making it extremely difficult for you to carry out your daily activities?

I... I feel like I keep repeating myself, doctor. Yes. As I just mentioned... I'm postponing my client follow-ups at the credit office. And... I used to make a point of attending those gallery events and the walking club, but I've stepped back from all of it. I really don't know what else to add.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are interfering with your daily life to the point where you're unable to carry out even the simplest tasks?

I... I'm sorry, I really don't know how many different ways I can say this. Yes, it's interfering. Like I said, I'm putting off my client follow-ups at work. I'm not going to the gallery or the walking club. I just... I'm not doing the things I used to do. I don't know what else you want me to tell you.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are causing you significant distress?
I suppose so. I mean... yes, it bothers me. I just... I don't really know how else to describe it. It's just heavy.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are causing you intense distress?
I... well, I wouldn't use the word "intense." It's just... always there. I think I already said it's just this heavy feeling. I don't really have anything else to add about it.
Would you say that these feelings of dull heaviness are causing you more distress than the impact they have on your daily activities?
I don't... I don't really know how to compare them. They're just both happening. I'm just tired of talking about it, to be honest.
Would you describe your feelings of dull heaviness as severely impairing your ability to function in daily life?

I don't know if I'd use the word severely. I mean... I guess I've been putting things off. I've started postponing some of my client follow-ups at the credit office. And... I suppose I've stepped back from the gallery events and the walking-club outings I used to make a point of going to. I just haven't been doing them.
Would you say that your feelings of dull heaviness are impairing your ability to function in daily life to a moderate or mild degree?
I don't... I really don't know how to grade it like that. Mild, moderate... I'm not sure. It's just getting in the way of things, like I said. I don't really have a specific word for it.
